title: Industrial Decarbonization Is Good for Business
gist: MIT researchers Elisabeth Reynolds and Nathan Collett argue that despite US federal hostility and European backsliding on climate policy, many multinational industrial firms (Siemens, Saint-Gobain, Outokumpu, Vicat's National Cement) are simultaneously raising productivity, growing revenue, and cutting emissions. They contend decarbonization succeeds because project-level economics, energy security, data-center demand and policies like the EU CBAM make it a winning business strategy.
